description: A user types a sentence into the photo search box. Trace how that sentence becomes an ordered list of photos: name each component in order, say where the sentence is turned into numbers, and where similarity is computed.
anchor_note: non-bug task: root_cause_symbols holds the anchor (entry point / changed symbol); RC metrics are reported for category A only
alternatives: New-shape requests take SearchService.searchSmartV3 -> SearchRepository.searchSmartV3 (search.service.ts:168-170 branch on isNewShapeRequest); same resolveEmbedding/encodeText link.
Query-by-asset: resolveEmbedding reads SearchRepository.getEmbedding instead of calling ML.

source.verification: Static (call-site reading). Candidate tests, UNVERIFIED names: server/src/services/search.service.spec.ts and server/test/medium/specs/services/search.service.spec.ts (smart search cases). History: commit b4cc406a3 (PR #29385) edited SearchService.searchSmart.
source.notes: The ML service itself is outside server/. Heavy computation is the remote ML call (text -> vector) and the pgvector ordering in SearchRepository.searchSmart; an answer that places similarity in the service layer is wrong.

notes: Path verified: search.controller.ts:90-91 -> SearchService.searchSmart (search.service.ts:168-198) -> resolveEmbedding (:325-352) -> MachineLearningRepository.encodeText -> predict -> SearchRepository.searchSmart (search.repository.ts:320, ORDER BY smart_search.embedding <=> ...) -> mapResponse.

SearchService.searchSmartV3 / SearchRepository.searchSmartV3 are a parallel valid answer for new-shape requests (search.service.ts:169-171,281-299), also using resolveEmbedding and a vector distance query. They should not be distractors (the draft itself lists them under alternatives).
